summary.en: View orders, payments, and catalog items

description.zh: 读取订单、支付、商品目录与客户信息，支持创建订单和退款。适合门店对账或查某笔交易。首次连接在浏览器登录 Square 授权。
description.en: Read orders, payments, catalog items, and customers, and create orders or refunds. Useful for store reconciliation or tracing a single transaction. Sign in to Square in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Square 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Square and authorize on first connect
